messages:
tara: Intake: vendor NightHawk requested a targeted pen test next week. Scope: staging, a few prod read-only APIs, KMS-wrapped artifacts, and console read-only for 60m. They also want audit logs and two retest slots.

joel: Do we have their assessor principals/IPs? Need to provision ephemeral roles and tag resources.

tara: Contact is ops@nlhsec.com. They'll provide IP CIDRs today. They insist on not receiving KMS keys directly.

maya: RBAC plan: create an IdP session role with 1h TTL scoped to resources tagged pt:nh-2026. No write perms. I'll open a change ticket with the policy diff + rollback to revoke the role.

eli: KMS approach: create a per-engagement DEK, wrap under alias/pt-nh-2026. Create a KMS grant to the ephemeral principal with EncryptionContext {pt-id:nh-2026}. We'll retire the grant post-engagement and rotate the DEK. Provide presigned S3 links for artifacts instead of broad S3 perms.

maya: For audit exports, we'll provide a CSV of auth and admin events (user, action, resource, ip, ts) and app request logs (req_id, endpoint, status). We'll redact emails and hash user ids for privacy.

audit-bot: scheduled: staging-maint-window 2026-05-10T02:00Z (3h). Confirm RBAC change in window?

tara: Yes apply RBAC + grants during that window. No prod changes.

joel: Retest windows: vendor asked for quick retest 24-48h after fixes and full retest one week later. Propose quick: 2026-05-11 14:00-16:00 UTC, full: 2026-05-18 10:00-13:00 UTC. Any conflicts?

eli: Infra OK. Pre-run checklist: snapshot logs, freeze deploys for 3h, mute noisy alerts for assessor IPs. I'll add to ticket.

maya: KMS note: export ListGrants/ListRetireGrant output for evidence. Include CloudTrail slice for key usage.

tara: Action items: joel open RBAC ticket (ENGSEC-2331) with rollback today; eli produce KMS runbook & CLI snippets tomorrow; maya prepare audit CSV + sample; joel + eli add pre-run checklist. I'll collect assessor IPs.

joel: Created ENGSEC-2331 and pinged legal for NDA addendum. Policy diff in ticket.

tara: Thanks all. I'll confirm NightHawk on retest windows and post IPs when available.
